sourceInventoryCoverage.observations: Unbathed bellows, two-post frame, crosspiece, bottom base, rod/knob and moving top plate are present. The hose exits the right plate region, dips toward the separate gauge and meets its cross-port. Side ruler and detached slanted thermometer remain outside the gas apparatus. Gauge has dial marks, pivot, long upper-right needle, opposite short tail, upright support and spread feet.

Expanded bellows remains within its frame; raised plate and high projecting rod/knob are visible. Open cylindrical bath and supporting block surround the apparatus. Thermometer runs down the bath's left side, beside and outside the bellows. Hose arches from the upper right apparatus down to the separate gauge. Gauge long needle points upper right, like a.

Bellows and moving plate are lower relative to their own apparatus than in b. Frame, central rod/knob, bath, supporting block and left bath thermometer remain. Hose connects the right apparatus to its separate gauge. Gauge long needle points lower right with the short opposite tail upper left, preserving the essential changed indication.
